  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,

  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_payment AS ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve AS er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cc.Claim_Identifier,
    pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage AS cc
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
  FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
  SELECT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(prole.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%policy%holder%' THEN apr.Party_Identifier END) AS policy_holder_party_identifier,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(prole.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%policy%holder%' THEN COALESCE(org.Organization_Name, CONCAT_WS(' ', person.First_Name, person.Middle_Name, person.Last_Name)) END) AS policy_holder,

    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(prole.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%agent%' THEN COALESCE(org.Organization_Name, CONCAT_WS(' ', person.First_Name, person.Middle_Name, person.Last_Name)) END) AS selling_agent

  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person AS person ON person.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier

WITH claim_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_payment lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve lr
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_payment ep
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.expense_reserve er
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ct.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    ct.Catastrophe_Type_Code,
    ct.Catastrophe_Name
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim c
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.catastrophe ct
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = ct.Catastrophe_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim_coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_party_identifier,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', per.First_Name, per.Middle_Name, per.Last_Name) AS policy_holder
  FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
  INNER JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role pr
    ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person per
    ON apr.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
  WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
),
policy_agents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_party_identifier,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', per.First_Name, per.Middle_Name, per.Last_Name) AS agent
  FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
  INNER JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role pr
    ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person per
    ON apr.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
  WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%agent%'
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    PolicyNo,
    SUM(Premium) AS premium_amount_paid
  FROM acme_insurance.main.fire_claim
  GROUP BY PolicyNo
)
SELECT
  cp.Claim_Identifier,
  cp.Company_Claim_Number,
  cp.Policy_Identifier,
  cp.Policy_Number,
  ph.policy_holder_party_identifier,
  ph.policy_holder,
  pa.agent_party_identifier,
  pa.agent,
  cp.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cp.Catastrophe_Type_Code,
  cp.Catastrophe_Name,
  MAX(cm.loss_payment_amount) AS loss_payment_amount,
  MAX(cm.loss_reserve_amount) AS loss_reserve_amount,
  MAX(cm.expense_payment_amount) AS expense_payment_amount,
  MAX(cm.expense_reserve_amount) AS expense_reserve_amount,
  MAX(pp.premium_amount_paid) AS premium_amount_paid
FROM claim_policies cp
LEFT JOIN claim_metrics cm
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = cm.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holders ph
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = ph.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agents pa
  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums pp
  ON cp.Policy_Number = pp.PolicyNo
GROUP BY
  cp.Claim_Identifier,
  cp.Company_Claim_Number,
  cp.Policy_Identifier,
  cp.Policy_Number,
  ph.policy_holder_party_identifier,
  ph.policy_holder,
  pa.agent_party_identifier,
  pa.agent,
  cp.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cp.Catastrophe_Type_Code,
  cp.Catastrophe_Name
LIMIT 500
